Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description: Job Title: Senior Data Scientist Location: Guadalajara, Mexico, Hybrid This is a remote/hybrid position, which will require the ability to be onsite in our Guadalajara, Mexico office as needed. Candidates must be based in Guadalajara. ABOUT THE COMPANY: Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth. With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate. Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future. THE OPPORTUNITY: At Salesloft, our Senior Data Scientists will be pivotal to our company's success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing Data Science team, taking full ownership of projects that redefine how sellers work and drive revenue. We believe that the most innovative products have a passionate and supportive research team behind them. On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for exploring and applying the latest advances in AI to solve real-world challenges for our customers. Specifically, you will: Apply your expertise in agentic systems, NLP, and machine learning to build solutions that enhance the productivity and effectiveness of sales professionals. Design and run robust experiments, translating ambiguous problems into concrete research questions and prototypes. Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering teams to ensure your research paves a clear path to production and delivers value to our users. Act as a thought leader and subject matter expert, identifying new opportunities for innovation and influencing the direction of our AI roadmap. In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will also have the opportunity to build revolutionary AI and ML systems that are changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: We are seeking a results-oriented, deeply curious, and strategic researcher who is passionate about owning their work and its impact. You are a leader and mentor who thrives on identifying gaps in knowledge and charting new paths for innovation. Specifically, you will play a pivotal role in helping us push the boundaries of what's possible in AI for sales by taking ownership of complex projects and seeing them through to completion. If you're looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Senior Data Scientist is the career path for you! THE TEAM: Our Salesloft Data Science team is comprised of seasoned and up-and-coming Data Scientists. Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired. The Data Science team consists of collaborative and self-motivated individuals who are passionate about their craft. We operate in a dynamic environment where our project timelines more closely align with engineering sprints than academic papers. We value intellectual curiosity and encourage researchers to voice feedback and help prioritize projects that will have the biggest impact. THE SKILL SET: 5+ years of overall experience as an AI Researcher, Data Scientist, or ML Engineer 1+ years of experience with deploying ML/AI features in production Demonstrated experience owning and leading research projects, from initial scoping and experimental design to delivering prototypes or production-ready models. Deep expertise in AI agent systems, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and classic machine learning methodologies. Proven ability to mentor and provide constructive feedback to junior researchers, elevating the work of the entire team. Experience translating complex research findings into actionable insights for cross-functional partners in product and engineering. Superb communication skills; you must be able to articulate complex technical concepts and advocate for strategic research directions Familiarity with python for data processing, ML, AI agents Familiarity with frameworks for agentic AI (LangGraph, Google ADK, Open AI Agents SDK etc) At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us! Title: Inventory Analyst
Description: About The Role We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Inventory Analyst to support inventory optimization, supply chain visibility, and data-driven decision making across the business. This role combines inventory management, forecasting, reporting, and process automation. The successful candidate will be responsible for analyzing inventory performance, identifying improvement opportunities, supporting planning activities, and developing reporting tools that enable operational excellence. The ideal candidate is passionate about data, process improvement, automation, and supply chain optimization. Key Responsibilities Inventory Analysis & Optimization Monitor and analyze inventory levels across the organization. Identify inventory deviations, shortages, excess stock, and optimization opportunities. Support inventory health initiatives and continuous improvement projects. Develop recommendations to improve inventory performance and working capital efficiency. Forecasting & Planning Support Support demand forecasting and inventory planning activities. Analyze consumption trends, inventory movements, and business requirements. Assist in budget and forecast preparation related to inventory management. Partner with stakeholders to improve inventory accuracy and planning effectiveness. Data Analytics & Reporting Develop and maintain inventory dashboards, reports, and KPI tracking tools. Analyze large datasets to provide business insights and support decision making. Build meaningful visualizations and performance indicators for management teams. Support inventory and supply chain reporting activities. Procurement & Order Management Support Create, manage, and coordinate purchase orders. Follow up on purchase order prioritization and fulfillment. Communicate order status to internal stakeholders. Coordinate with internal customers, suppliers, affiliates, and external vendors. Automation & Digitalization Identify opportunities to automate reporting and inventory management processes. Develop solutions using: Power BI Power Automate Copilot KNIME Other analytical and automation tools Support digital transformation initiatives within Supply Chain and Operations. Required Qualifications Education Bachelor’s degree in: Industrial Engineering, International Business, Foreign Trade, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Analytics, or related disciplines Professional Experience Experience in inventory analysis and inventory management. Experience working with supply chain, logistics, planning, procurement, or operations teams. Experience supporting forecasting, inventory planning, or budget activities. Experience analyzing large datasets and generating actionable business insights. Required Technical Skills Advanced Microsoft Excel: Pivot Tables Advanced Formulas Large Databases Data Analysis Macros Power BI (Intermediate to Advanced). Data analysis and reporting. Forecasting and inventory planning concepts. KPI development and monitoring. Highly Desired Power Automate. KNIME. Microsoft Copilot and AI-assisted productivity tools. Process automation experience. SAP or other ERP systems. Inventory, purchasing, and supply chain analytics. Competencies Strong analytical mindset. Attention to detail. Problem-solving skills. Process improvement orientation. Data-driven decision making. Excellent communication and stakeholder management. Ability to work independently and collaboratively. Proactive attitude and continuous improvement mindset. Language Requirements Advanced English (written and spoken). Work Model Hybrid work model. Equal Opportunity Statement We are committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, marital status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We believe diversity of thought, background, and experience strengthens our teams and drives innovation.

Title: Senior Engineer - Data Engineer
Description: Company Description We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at scale — across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (15000+ experts across 26 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in! Job Description Role and Responsibility: Design & Build Data Models: Architect and develop scalable, performant data models in Snowflake using dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas), OBT, and Data Vault patterns. You''''ll own the data warehouse layer that powers analytics and reporting across the organization. Develop & Maintain dbt Projects: Build, test, and document dbt models end-to-end — staging, intermediate, and mart layers. Enforce best practices including version control, CI/CD, data contracts, and comprehensive testing (schema, data, and freshness tests). Snowflake Cost Optimization: Monitor and optimize Snowflake compute and storage costs. This includes warehouse sizing and auto-suspend tuning, query profiling, clustering key strategies, materialization choices, and implementing resource monitors to control spend. Data Pipeline Development: Design and build robust ELT/ETL data pipelines to ingest, transform, and deliver data from diverse sources (ERP, MES, IoT, APIs, flat files) into Snowflake/ AWS Glue/ Lambda. Automate workflows using orchestration tools and Python scripting. Data Quality & Governance: Implement data quality checks, lineage tracking, and documentation standards. Champion data governance practices to ensure trusted, reliable data across the organization. Expectation from the Candidate: Experience: 3+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related role, with hands-on Snowflake and dbt experience in a production environment. Technical Prowess: Expert-level Snowflake skills: data modeling, performance tuning, query optimization, Snowpark, stored procedures, streams/tasks, data sharing, and cost management. Strong dbt proficiency: model development, Jinja/macros, packages, incremental models, snapshots, exposures, and CI/CD integration. Advanced SQL skills for complex transformations, window functions, CTEs, and analytical queries. Proficiency in Python for data pipeline development, automation, scripting, and API integrations. Experience with dashboard/BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) including data source optimization and DAX/LOD calculations. Cloud platform experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP) including storage, compute, networking, and infrastructure-as-code basics. Qualifications Must have skills: Cloud development (Strong), DBT, SQL (Expert), Snowflake

Title: Finance Costing COE Data & Integration Lead
Description: Description - HP is launching a Costing Transformation Program to simplify, standardize and modernize costing across the company. The program will establish a consistent enterprise framework and governance, enabling faster insights, greater pricing agility and better business decisions . Our ambition is to create a unified, globally harmonized Fully Burdened Cost ecosystem that connects costing with pricing, supply chain and financial processes. The future-state model will provide greater end-to-end visibility, agility and control, while maintaining the financial integrity and compliance required to support HP’s future growth. At the center of the transformation, HP is establishing a Finance-led Costing Center of Excellence (CoE) responsible for enterprise costing standards, methodologies, process design, governance and business alignment. The CoE will partner closely with Personal Systems, Print, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Digital, Pricing and other business and functional teams. We are looking for individuals with a strong costing and/or Supply Chain cost-accounting background who are excited about the opportunity to challenge the status quo and shape how costing should work at HP in the future . This is not a lift-and-shift of today’s processes into new technology. CoE team members will help simplify existing complexity, challenge legacy practices, harmonize processes and methodologies, and translate deep costing expertise into scalable solutions. As an early member of the Costing CoE, you will not simply join an established organization. You will help build it, shape its operating model and influence one of HP’s key Finance transformations from the ground up. Required Qualifications And Experience Strong product-costing and cost-accounting background, with a solid understanding of how product costs are developed, maintained, analyzed and used in business decisions. Experience with standard cost, material cost, bill-of-material cost structures, cost rollups, burden and overhead rates, allocation methodologies, purchase-price impacts, manufacturing costs and cost variances. Strong understanding of end-to-end costing dependencies across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Product Management, Engineering, Pricing and Digital. Ability to assess current-state processes, identify unnecessary complexity and design simplified, standardized future-state solutions. Hands-on problem-solving capability, including the ability to independently analyze data and processes, develop recommendations, document future-state requirements and drive implementation. Experience working across functions and geographies, with strong communication and influencing skills. Ability to challenge established practices constructively and distinguish genuine business-model requirements from legacy process preferences. Strong analytical skills and ability to work with large, complex product and costing data sets. Experience supporting process transformation, ERP implementation, systems modernization or enterprise operating-model change. Strong understanding of financial controls, data traceability, reconciliation and auditability. Preferred Profile Deep Personal Systems costing experience is strongly preferred, including knowledge of PS product structures, SKU and AV complexity, bills of material, commodity cost movements, product lifecycle events and hardware-costing processes. Supply Chain cost-accounting experience is strongly preferred, particularly experience connecting operational cost drivers with financial costing and accounting outcomes. Experience in hardware, technology, manufacturing or similarly complex product environments. Familiarity with HP costing processes, tools, data structures and current organizational handoffs. Common posting language This is a hands-on transformation role. It is not limited to documenting the current state or providing subject-matter advice. The successful candidate will be expected to analyze complex costing issues, challenge legacy practices, design future-state standards and processes, develop detailed requirements, support testing and implementation, and help drive adoption across HP. Candidates with strong Personal Systems product-costing experience are particularly encouraged to apply. Supply Chain Finance and cost-accounting professionals with experience connecting BOM, material, manufacturing, procurement and operational cost drivers to financial costing outcomes are also strongly preferred. The pay range for this role is $105,050 to $161,800 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related Benefits knowledge, skills, and experience. HP offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position, including: Health insurance Dental insurance Vision insurance Long term/short term disability insurance Employee assistance program Flexible spending account Life insurance Generous time off policies, including; 4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure 11 paid holidays Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave (US benefits overview [https://hpbenefits.ce.alight.com/]) The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Specialist partners with Performance program owners and cross-functional teams to help deliver global performance cycles and advance data, digital, and AI-enabled capabilities. Business requirements and system readiness: Help translate business needs into documented requirements, acceptance criteria, and readiness plans. Coordinate business User Acceptance Testing, issue tracking, retesting, sign-off, and launch-readiness activities in partnership with HRIS and HRIT. Digital and AI-enabled transformation: Support the responsible adoption of digital and AI-enabled Performance Management capabilities. Identify opportunities to simplify work, improve user experience, automate recurring activities, and measure adoption and benefits while keeping human judgment and accountability at the center. Resources, enablement, and content quality: Coordinate the development, review, maintenance, and publishing readiness of Performance Management resources, including guides, FAQs, knowledge articles, training materials, and partner-readiness content. Promote consistency, accuracy, accessibility, and a simplified user experience. Program effectiveness and continuous improvement: Use surveys, focus groups, operational feedback, data, and cycle retrospectives to assess program effectiveness. Document lessons learned and recommend practical improvements to processes, resources, systems, and stakeholder experiences. Experience with HR platforms, reporting or dashboard tools, digital transformation, or AI-enabled solutions is an advantage. Analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into meaningful insights and clear recommendations. Strong communication and presentation skills, with a talent for making complex topics simple and engaging. Interest in digital, AI, automation, and emerging HR technologies, with a passion for exploring new ways of working. Understanding of business requirements, UAT, system readiness, and process implementation. Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills across HR, technology, analytics, and business teams. Creative problem-solving and continuous-improvement mindset, with a focus on simplification and user experience. Working knowledge of HR governance, privacy, security, audit, and compliance considerations.
